verdict.rationale: A desktop operating system could plausibly ship a built-in assistant that acts as an MCP client, so this axis applies, but the evidence pack never mentions MCP or any built-in agent that can consume external tool servers. The claims that Ubuntu is a platform for 'AI/ML software' describe hosting third-party apps, not the product itself plugging in MCP servers, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
